name: Precise Strikes (Combat)
body:
You have learned to trade potency for accuracy when needed.

Prerequisite(s): Sneak Attack 2d6.

Benefit: Whenever you make an attack roll that would qualify as a sneak attack you may reduce your total sneak attack dice for that attack to a minimum of one sneak attack die. For each die you reduce your sneak attack damage, that attack roll gains a +2 bonus to the attack roll.
